steps.title: Evaporation
steps.description: The Sun heats water in oceans, lakes and rivers, turning it into invisible water vapor that rises into the air. Plants also release vapor from their leaves.

steps.title: Condensation
steps.description: As the vapor rises it cools and turns into tiny droplets that gather to form clouds and fog.

steps.title: Precipitation
steps.description: When droplets grow heavy enough, they fall back to the ground as rain, snow, sleet or hail.

steps.title: Collection
steps.description: Water runs off into rivers, lakes and oceans or soaks into the ground as groundwater, ready to evaporate again.
